I will keep this small beans plot low-cost because my land here is very small and I cannot put much cash there. Last season I managed with saved seed and manure from home, and for beans I do not like buying fertilizer unless I have seen it pay well on a plot like mine. I will plant with the rains, weed by hand, and use my family labor because hiring people for 0.06 hectares is money I need for food and other farm needs.
